notes: Read-only Tier-1 capture on a healthy running linux2rest (Rust binary PID 855, user root, comm linux2rest). CPU/RSS via tools/sample_resource.sh (--pid 855, 90 samples, label running_baseline; periodic sampler timers per --log-settings intervals). SLO via tools/probe_http.sh on nine GET routes under /system-information/ (--repeats 60). Observed REST API is UNVERSIONED at runtime: routes are directly under /system-information/ with no /v1 prefix (observed_facts versions list empty). ALL routes are read-only GETs — no mutating routes exist on linux2rest. Raw evidence: /tmp/linux2rest_sample.json, /tmp/linux2rest_slo.json.

route_inventory.note: linux2rest exposes only read-only GET routes; no POST/PUT/DELETE or settings mutation endpoints exist.

running_baseline.note: GET contracts on a healthy running linux2rest serving host system telemetry on port 6030 (nginx /system-information/).

slo_running_baseline.note: GET /system-information/system returns the full consolidated snapshot JSON; GET /system-information/system/process returns the full process list and is among the heaviest routes.

running_baseline.method: /proc stat deltas, top-style (100 == 1 core), PID 855 linux2rest (Rust binary, not python)
running_baseline.note: Rust binary with periodic sampler timers (netstat=30s, process=60s, etc.); RSS flat ~28.1 MB. CPU mostly idle (~0% median) with spikes during sampler ticks (max 40.92%).

navigator.firmware: n/a (linux2rest reports host platform/hardware; does not depend on flight-controller firmware)
navigator.notes: GET /system-information/platform returned Raspberry Pi 4 B / BCM2711 on this Navigator host; service behavior is platform-independent but response content reflects the connected board.

state_machine: none (external Rust binary; no in-repo state machine)
settings_mutations: none — read-only service with no on-disk settings paths; no mutating routes exist.
